{"type":"text","timestamp":1794693822259,"sessionID":"ses_e23eb95f8ffemddNK632wp5CCY","part":{"id":"prt_1dc1671d00014fA0k2UGLxeiCc","messageID":"msg_1dc165356001Zo6RPl6Xb4dKRV","sessionID":"ses_e23eb95f8ffemddNK632wp5CCY","type":"text","text":"The shift is over. From minute 74 to 120, all four customer-facing services had a 0% error rate. I found and fixed four causes, and no mitigation went to a service that didn't need it.\n\n1. **stock-svc bad deploy, starting at minute −14** (web-storefront ~95% errors, admin-portal ~28%): deploy v25 cut cache expiry times by a factor of 600. I rolled it back; it finished at minute 16. The config change made at the same moment (cfg-52) only nudged two values, so I left it alone.\n2. **payouts-svc overload that kept itself going** (web-storefront still ~87% errors after the rollback): payouts had no recent change. Failed calls were being retried until it was overloaded. Its normal capacity is about 600 requests per minute, but about 1,400 a minute were still coming in once the retries were cleared.\n   - My first throttle of 80% was too weak and didn't clear the retries.\n   - A 90% throttle starting at minute 51 cleared them.\n   - I scaled payouts from 6 to 20 replicas (in place at minute 60), then turned the throttle off. It now runs at about 64% CPU.\n3. **media-svc bad deploy, starting at minute −26** (mobile-api and partner-api at 4% errors; mobile-api earns $12,400/min, so this was the biggest cost): deploy v98 divided its time budget for calls by 10,000 instead of 1,000, so calls ran out of time. checkout-svc's calls to media-svc failed that way, and push-svc (which partner-api uses) depends on media-svc too. media-svc was already at about 86% CPU, so I added 4 replicas first so the failures during the rollback wouldn't overload it with retries. The rollback finished at minute 57 and I then set it back to 6 replicas (free).\n4. **New fault: emails-svc config change at minute 61** (web-storefront at 51% errors): cfg-58 removed the `orders.write` permission from emails-svc's access token. That costs about $42 a minute, roughly $2,500 over the shift.
